'''Raidhen of Hol Cuchone''' is a ruler of a country that existed four hundred years after the Breaking, around {{ab|400}}.

[[N'Delia Basolaine]], First Maid and Swordfast to Radhen was believed to have translated ''[[Prophecies of the Dragon|The Prophecies of the Dragon]]. ''{{ref|{{twotc}}, Raidhen of Hol Cuchone}}
